prediction.rationale: The last two sessions rebounded +7.0% (3302.55→3535.14). On 20260805 the index gapped down to 3372.08 (the day's low), was fully absorbed and driven to close at 3535.14 near the 3584.06 high — a bullish reversal candle on the window's largest turnover (amount 382.6B, vol 49.9M), and volume has expanded on up days (0731 51.5M, 0804 44.2M, 0805 49.9M), signaling accumulation rather than a dead-cat bounce. Lows have risen since the 0730 trough (3158→3281→3342→3372) and the close is back above the 0728 crash candle's high (3511.7), repairing structure; it is now the 3rd-highest close of the ten sessions. Supplementary news notes ChiNext PE-TTM ~37.7x at a ~1.6% one-year percentile, a valuation floor that encourages dip-buying flows (https://cj.sina.cn/articles/view/5570287027/14c03d5b302001p9xg). However, overhead supply sits at 3575-3592 (0723 close/0727 high) and 3621, 0805 stalled at 3584, and this window's regime has alternated hard (most up days were followed by pullbacks), so after +7% in two days a modest follow-through 'up' (0-1%) is favored over 'strong_up'.
prediction.market_analysis: A ChiNext-led advance would signal returning risk appetite in the broad market: with ~54.7% of index weight in the top ten names, moves are driven by the battery chain (CATL), AI optical modules (Innolight, Eoptolink, TFC), fintech/brokers (East Money), power equipment (Sungrow) and semiconductor equipment (Changchuan), so tech-hardware and new-energy sectors should outperform while SH/SZ composites likely track with less beta. Confirmation would come from sustained ChiNext turnover above ~350-380B yuan and holds above the 3372/3489 supports; a rejection at 3575-3592 would instead favor rotation into defensives/value and a retest of those supports, with high-volatility 3-7% daily swings still the operating norm.
